body: **2026-10-05-ci-gate-legs** — wired ci.yml's `a11y` job ("Accessibility (a11y) tests", `ci-leg.sh a11y`) into the slow tier with no required status check, the origin of decision/a11y-ci-gate and decision/a11y-ci-leg; a canvas-lint test that joins the a11y leg widens this existing job, never a new job or status check.

Matters because a canvas finding names the canvas element by its stable id (Circle Drawer's canvas is keyed), never a command identity this chunk mints.

**2026-10-12-headless-screenshot** — made the driver's `screenshot` one more reader of the snapshot model's bounds, changing nothing (no focus move, empty next diff); the canvas's circles and labels leave as shot pixels on this reader, and a canvas lint read must likewise change nothing.

**2026-10-13-stand-contrast-harness** — built `Harness::text_contrast` (WCAG 2.x `contrast_ratio`, `required_ratio` 3.0 large at 24 px / 14 pt bold, else 4.5; background composited to the first opaque ancestor; `None` under opacity < 1, a filter or a background image) and `stand_contrast`; the one formula and threshold a canvas text-contrast candidate (text against the fill painted under it) must reuse (decision/wcag-contrast-thresholds, decision/text-contrast-required-ratio, decision/stand-contrast-measured).

**2026-10-14-quality-gates** — every `stand_*` file runs three rounds in `stand-repeat` under the zero-failure budget (decision/stand-checks-repeated-three-rounds); a new `stand_` canvas-lint check lands there by its prefix and must be deterministic across three rounds and both layout modes.

**2026-10-19-visual-lint** (`text_contrast`'s first non-test caller) — `Session::lint`'s `contrast` reading goes through `text_contrast`, reported below `required_ratio()`, exempt exactly where `enabled` reads `Some(false)`, `None` not measured, no second formula or threshold; the stand at boot reads no `contrast` finding. Precedent for any canvas contrast check: same reader, same exempt rule, no second threshold (decision/lint-contrast-single-formula, decision/contrast-exempt-disabled-controls).

**2026-10-19-visual-lint** (the gated part: the contrast reading through the `lint` verb) — the lint reached every carrier as the `lint` verb on the founder's F1 «Новая команда lint», and a `contrast` finding is written `id` · `defect` · `bounds` · `ratio` · `required`, ids, closed words and numbers only (contract/visual-lint-finding/content, contract/lint-contrast-finding/*). A canvas finding added to the `lint` answer must keep this shape; how it reaches the caller is the chunk's crossing fork.

**2026-10-20-select-by-id** — dropped the visual lint's «PROVISIONAL: in process only» on the founder's word (the lint F1 «Новая команда lint»): precedent that the lint's carriage was ratified as a founder fork, so a new canvas carrier or defect-word set on it is likewise a fork per the 2026-10-10 field rule.

**2026-10-24-a11y-re-read** — the a11y leg widened to fourteen files on the founder's P4 fork («Плюс проверки дерева»), each joining file a witness, tree reading or recorded gap; a canvas-lint test joining the leg changes that file count, which the capability statement's pin reads (decision/a11y-test-leg).

**2026-10-25-capability-statement** — `docs/capabilities.md` publishes `## Accessibility reach` (tier 0, SC 2.1.1 · 1.4.3 · 2.4.3 only, the AT reading unmeasured) and a change to the reach is written there by hand (decision/capability-statement-reach-by-hand, decision/accessibility-reach-tier-0); the scope names the capability statement if a carrier changes.

**2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar** (the lint's option overlap) — the stand at boot read one lint finding, an `overlap` of the flight booker's select options (`stand_lint` `[0, 1, 0, 0]`), a driver defect for every document re-pinned as measured and owned by a residual; precedent and trap for "reads clean on the stand": a new geometric check must be run against the stand at boot (decision/stand-lint-clean-at-boot).

**2026-10-26-codebase-health** — the stand-repeat `--test` list's membership is held jointly by `stand_requirement_sweep`'s leg check (which reads `ci-leg.sh` whole by `contains`) and `test_stand_repeat_leg_runs_three_rounds`; trap if the chunk adds a named witness outside the `stand_` prefix to either leg.

**2026-10-31-engine-debts** (the lint's closed-select overlap ended) — `overlaps` skips a closed select's options in every document via `Entry.in_closed_select`, reading the element and never the role; the stand at boot reads no finding of any kind, `[0, 0, 0, 0]` (decision/stand-lint-clean-at-boot). The canvas lint must keep this at-boot reading clean on the four lean tasks in both modes.

**2026-10-31-select-popup** (the visual lint over an open list) — the lint's exclusion widened to `Entry.in_select_box`, and `clip_region` takes an open row's region from `visible_region` alone, no `contain: paint` cut; precedent for how the lint defines a region and a clip, which the canvas overflow check's region (content box and pushed clips) must settle against.

**2026-11-18-capability-statement** — decision/capability-statement-reach-by-hand's why now reads that the capability statement's pin reads only the a11y leg's file count among the section's claims; adding a canvas-lint file to the a11y leg moves a pinned number, the rest edited by hand.

Precedent for a painted-pair contrast reading (as a canvas fill under text would be) entering through the one formula, never a second threshold.

**2026-11-23-circle-drawer-on-a-canvas** — + decision/circle-drawer-canvas-pixels-only: Circle Drawer's drawing area is one keyed, clickable canvas node (role group, named Drawing area) whose circles and diameter labels reach no DOM, snapshot, tree, UI graph or lint; the stand the canvas lint must read clean, and the row a canvas finding would amend (it says «or lint»).

**2026-11-24T06-11-11-wrap** — decision/circle-drawer-canvas-pixels-only ratified by the founder («Подтвердить (Recommended)»), state standing; any change to what leaves the canvas (a lint finding about its labels) amends a founder-ratified row.

**2026-11-24-upstream-sync-ahead-of-inside-the-canvas** — + absence/keyboard-drag-and-drop in §1 A11y Scope Summary, the merge immediately before the canvas work; recorded so the scope's stated absences are read beside the canvas chunk's a11y n/a claims.

**2026-11-24-canvas-draw-commands** (circle-drawer-canvas-pixels-only · readers-of-one-snapshot-model) — the canvas's circles and labels now also leave as the `canvas` verb's draw commands, no label's text among them, and the canvas read is no reader of the snapshot model; the chunk's checks run over these same draw commands, so a canvas finding must carry no glyph, text or font and the row's «reach no … lint» clause is what a canvas lint must amend.

**2026-11-24-canvas-draw-commands** (snapshot-model-single-source) — decision/snapshot-model-single-source gained that the canvas read, reading one canvas element's draw commands, is no reader of the snapshot model; a canvas lint reading draw commands sits outside the snapshot model's readers, unlike the DOM lint.

Among them at least a label (a glyph run) overflowing its region; other candidates (a command wholly outside the content box, a zero-area shape, text contrast against the fill painted under it) are P3/P4's to choose.

body: The lint's findings: a new kind of finding read inside a canvas element over its recorded draw commands, where the DOM lint sees the canvas only as one element.

A label overflowing its region: a glyph run drawn outside the region meant to hold it — before virtual nodes, the canvas's content box and any clip the widget pushed around the run; which regions count is P3's.

The glyph run's measured extent: the canvas reading holds glyph origins only, not advance or ink extent; whether the check needs the font's advances through the engine's shared Parley font context is P3's to measure.

The finding's content and fields if it rides the lint answer: a closed defect word, the element id, its bounds, as the lint's existing finding fields (id, bounds, defect) are stated; a new closed defect word inside a ratified carrier is no widening per the founder's ruling, a new carrier, open value set or authored text is.
A canvas finding names the canvas element by its stable id, never a draw command's identity minted by this chunk.
No glyph id, glyph position, text, font bytes or family name crosses any carrier; the canvas crossing stands provisional awaiting the founder.
No new verb, carrier, exit, cause, session error, log field or span unless a fork's answer adds one; escher's own log targets keep text and value redacted.

If a text-contrast-against-fill check is built, it reads its ratio through the one contrast formula the lint and harness share (WCAG ratio matching Chrome, the SC 1.4.3 required ratio) and the carve-outs that formula honours.
Circle Drawer's drawing area, a named canvas node painted from Rust, reads clean under the canvas lint on the stand; the stand reads no lint finding at boot.
A planted fixture whose canvas holds a label overflowing its region, named by the canvas lint — the v040-10 acceptance clause.
Proven in both layout modes, as every stand check.
The capability statement and the help self-description change, by hand, only if a carrier changes; the kept-check recording if the lint answer changes.
The driver's element shot of Circle Drawer's canvas, its diameter label on whole device pixels, keeps its cross-OS digest watch (carried freight); the chunk must not disturb what that shot paints.
New stand checks run in the accessibility test leg and the stand checks repeated three rounds, gating CI.

body: Keyboard navigation — Tab order, focus, keyboard activation, range input and select list keys, Cells grid and CRUD list keys: the chunk reads draw commands and adds no input behaviour.
ARIA patterns and roles — role mapping and hidden-content rows: the canvas lint maps no role and changes no tree membership.
Accessibility tree states and ARIA name and property reads — checked, pressed, selected, invalid, describedby, labelledby, level: no ARIA attribute is read or written.

The platform adapter and accessibility-feature wiring — AccessKit adapter choice, feature defaults, no adapter on stand binaries, assistive-technology reach, keyboard drag and drop: the chunk touches no adapter or feature gate.
Cognitive accessibility — invalid state not by colour or class alone, shared tab order table for focus: no form state is involved.

Proves it on a planted fixture whose canvas holds an overflowing label, named by the canvas lint, and on the stand (Circle Drawer's canvas) reading clean, in both layout modes.
How a canvas finding reaches the caller (new closed defect words in the lint answer, a field of the canvas answer, or in process only) is a crossing; every fork goes to the founder and the phase stops there.
Re-reads the verdict of the CI run on the take-up tree, whose earlier run was cancelled by a superseding push.

body_fields.what: the canvas reading — the canvas verb's reader that records an app widget's draw commands, glyph runs held by the box of their glyph origins — edits: Session::canvas, the canvas answer
the driver's lint — the lint verb's findings answer and its six closed defect words — edits: Session::lint, the closed defect word set
the capability statement, pinned to the driver schema, naming each claim's checks — edited only if a carrier changes
the help self-description of the driver's verbs and answers — edited only if a carrier changes

body: A canvas lint finding a label whose glyphs are drawn outside the region meant to hold them (the canvas content box and any clip the widget pushed around the run), named on a planted fixture and reading clean on Circle Drawer's canvas.

The lint verb's answer: its findings list, their order and its closed set of defect words (clipped, contrast, off-screen, overlap, truncated, zero-size); a canvas finding may join it only as a new word of that closed set, which is a fork outcome.
The canvas verb's answer and the canvas command line: a canvas finding may instead be a field of that answer, again only as a fork outcome; the commands table held across hosts stays as it reads.

No new verb, carrier, exit code, refusal cause, session error, log field or span unless a founder's fork answer adds one; a new field of a closed value set inside a ratified carrier is no widening, a new carrier, open value set or authored text is.
Content-free answers: no glyph id, glyph position, text, font bytes or family name crosses any carrier, and driver log lines keep fixed words and counts only.
A canvas finding names the canvas element by its stable element id, never an identity minted for a draw command.

The glyph run's measured extent: the reading holds glyph origins only, so a run past its region by its last glyph's advance reads inside; whether the check reads font advances through the shared font context is P3's — font-metric checks on the bundled real font, never skipped.
Stand checks in both layout modes, under the bundled font, witnessed inside the repeated stand rounds with a zero-failure budget.

Canvas text on whole device pixels and the Circle Drawer canvas shot compared across linux, windows and macOS by digest (the cross-OS stand canvas check, a watch carried at 2 of 3 green runs) stays green; no shot enters a cross-OS byte comparison.
If a text-contrast canvas check is built, it uses the one WCAG 2.x contrast formula and required ratio of the harness's text contrast reading, and the reader changes nothing.

If a carrier changes, the capability statement's claim sections and counts held to the schema, each claim naming its checks, and the help self-description kept in parity on the command line and MCP surfaces.
If the lint answer changes, the committed recorded checks re-recorded so they stay byte-equal to the binary's recording.
A lint check over the canvas is a reading: it changes nothing on the instance and echoes no caller input.
The planted fixture: test data stated in code, a shared fixture stated once in the shared fixture module, the stand booting offline.
The CI verdict of the take-up tree re-read: a run cancelled by a superseding push or the hosted runner is answered by reading or re-running, a red dispositioned when it lands.

body_fields.convention: each new test is controlled red-before-green, its control recorded with its red reading, and a control edit leaves earlier targets green
each new expected value pinned as a literal; table-driven tests assert their row count; failures print no argument value
unit tests sit in their source file's inline or sibling test module; one integration test target per file, shared test modules are no target
each new stand or session check owns its host, uses no sleep or wall-clock read, and socket or command-line targets are unix-gated
each new test file joins its CI legs and keeps them; per-crate coverage floors and the cognitive-complexity ceiling hold

body: WPT conformance runner, its CLI, status set, outputs and pinned commit: the chunk touches no web-platform conformance.
Cold-agent pipe: its verbs, events, verdict, exit codes, tasks and isolation; no live agent run is part of this chunk.
agent-run verbs, selections, events, state and exit codes: the five-command harness contract is unchanged.
Session wire framing, socket, hello and lifecycle bounds, session state directory and idle expiry: the transport is unchanged.
Handler coverage and its coverage line, including canvas handlers left uncounted: the chunk counts no handlers.
Virtual nodes and the virtual element id form: grouping commands by a virtual node and naming a changed command belong to a later entry.
Harness time, settle, advance and timer ticks, network stand-ins and load waits: the lint reads a settled canvas and drives no clock.
Typed password masking, select-row colours, select list painting, scrollbar fade and caret placement: no form control is touched.
CI supply chain: actions pinned to SHAs, secrets, read-only permissions, package-install scripts and their exit codes, Skia archive, upstream-only publishing jobs.
Upstream blitz-dom test and manifest carve-outs, buffered-render bridge tests and upstream oversize or duplicate files: no upstream code is synced here.
The graph and actions verbs, their arguments and the caused-owner reading: the chunk changes neither.
The windowed end-to-end absence and the mocking-library absence: the chunk launches no window and mocks nothing.
